source.rule: MONIT=Y stores each item PM counter on the physical item. SYS-SWAP and LRU-OP3 are distinct PMIDs; a SYS-SWAP system replacement removes and overhauls original item ID0, returns it to stock, and LRU-OP3 later reinstalls it. This continuation tests whether the original item triggers its own LRU-OP3 after renewed operation.

hypothesis_before_native.common: The accepted first three missions and exchange sequence recur. A fourth two-hour mission starts h44 after original monitored item ID0 was physically reinstalled at h34.
hypothesis_before_native.monitored: If original item ID0 retains its two LRU-OP3 operation hours accumulated before SYS-SWAP and unrelated item overhaul, the fourth mission raises it to four and its LRU-OP3 PM starts h46. If that distinct counter reset, no LRU-OP3 PM should occur at h46.
hypothesis_before_native.system-converted: The system-level LRU-OP3 counter was last reset at h22 and should reach its next threshold after missions ending h34 and h46, making a converted-arm PM at h46 a schedule control.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Both arms must exactly roundtrip authored tables, calculate with zero conversion errors, valid nonempty event/report output, and no incomplete PM runtime warning.
Both arms must reconcile four mission outcomes, PMID-specific system/item PM starts/completions, physical item IDs, stock issues/returns, and 96 aligned half-hour report bins.

Full retained-counter inference for D14.var03 requires monitored physical ID0 to be the item on the fourth mission and LRU-OP3 at h46 after its earlier h8-10 use; any differing result narrows or rejects the inference.
A separate read-only reviewer must replay frozen input and raw evidence without importing the author implementation.
limits: One seed, one aircraft, one stocked item, one system swap, one item PM interval, and one post-reinstallation mission only.
The SYS-SWAP removal includes a different-PMID item overhaul; this test isolates LRU-OP3 recurrence, not all maintenance effects on age.
Counter age is inferred from event timing and physical IDs, not directly exposed in native report.
GUI visual content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
